accounts.name: owner
accounts.desc: The vault's single owner (docs/vault-design.md §1). Pays for and controls the vault; the only signer ever authorized to withdraw.

accounts.name: vaultState
accounts.desc: Vault state PDA, seeds [b"vault", owner] (§3). Created by this instruction using the robust pre-funding-safe pattern (§10).

accounts.name: vaultTokenAccount
accounts.desc: Program-derived Token-2022 token account, seeds [b"vault_token", vaultState] (§2/§3). Authority is vaultState, never the owner directly.

accounts.name: mint
accounts.desc: The Token-2022 mint this vault holds. Checked against the extension allow/deny list (§7) before the token account is created.

accounts.name: tokenProgram
accounts.desc: Must equal the hardcoded Token-2022 program ID (checklist item 11, InvalidCpiTarget) — never an attacker-supplied program ID.

accounts.name: systemProgram
accounts.desc: Native System Program, used for the pre-funding-safe account creation pattern (§10).

accounts.name: depositor
accounts.desc: Any signer may deposit (docs/vault-design.md §1) — deposits are permissionless top-ups, not owner-restricted.

accounts.name: vaultState
accounts.desc: Vault state PDA, seeds [b"vault", owner] (§3). Must already be initialized and owned by this program.

accounts.name: vaultTokenAccount
accounts.desc: Program-derived Token-2022 token account, re-derived from vaultState and compared against the stored address (checklist item 9).

accounts.name: depositorTokenAccount
accounts.desc: Depositor's own Token-2022 token account for the vault's mint; source of the transfer_checked CPI.

accounts.name: mint
accounts.desc: The Token-2022 mint this vault holds — used for transfer_checked's decimals check.

accounts.name: tokenProgram
accounts.desc: Must equal the hardcoded Token-2022 program ID (checklist item 11, InvalidCpiTarget).

accounts.name: owner
accounts.desc: Must equal vault_state.owner (checklist item 7, NotVaultOwner) — the one instruction this checklist item guards.

accounts.name: vaultState
accounts.desc: Vault state PDA, seeds [b"vault", owner] (§3). Re-derived using the stored canonical bump, never a caller-supplied one (checklist item 8).

accounts.name: vaultTokenAccount
accounts.desc: Program-derived Token-2022 token account. Authority is vaultState, so the withdraw CPI is invoke_signed by the program, never the human owner.

accounts.name: destinationTokenAccount
accounts.desc: Destination Token-2022 token account for the withdrawn funds; target of the transfer_checked CPI.
